My parental leave starts on Monday 2 February and I plan to be back on Tuesday 1 September, though HR says the return date can slip to the end of October if the nursery place falls through. Before I go I need to hand over the monthly volunteer rota, the venue bookings for the spring fair, and the shared mailbox routine. text:
We fly from Manchester to Erbil on Friday 22 August, leaving at 06:50, and come back on 7 September. My brother, Rebwar Sofi, has booked the airport transfer for 03:30, but the minibus only seats six and there will be seven of us, so someone needs a second car.

The luggage is the other problem, because Cresthaven Air allows one free checked bag each and we are bringing a folded cot for my cousin's baby, which counts as an extra bag. Zhiar Talabani at the travel desk said they can add an extra bag for 40 pounds.

By then I will be 31 weeks pregnant and the airline wants a doctor's letter confirming I am fit to fly after 28 weeks. My midwife said the scan on 5 August should show whether the baby is growing normally, and she will only sign the letter if it does. If the letter is delayed we may have to move the flight, which would cost a 90-pound change fee per passenger.
